requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP (Allegato n. 10, CCNL 23 May 2022, pp. 122-123): two levels below the destination in the first 12 months, one level below in the next 12, the destination in the last 12 (Area 1 and 2: 36 months; Area 3: 24 months, from one level below, only for the highest provincial level of the area). The levels are the provincial professional levels inside each area, not the three national areas the file holds: the file places an Area1 apprentice at the Area3 and then the Area2 minimum, a reading the text does not support. A fixed-term apprentice operaio is never paid below the lowest level of the destination area (p. 125).
requirements.remediation: Model the provincial levels of each area, or pass the apprentice classification of the provincial contract.

requirements.rule: CPL TIMING: the minimi di area of the renewal of 28/05/2026 (Allegato n. 1, p. 52) apply from 1 June 2026 only in the provinces without a contratto provinciale di lavoro (CPL); where a CPL is in force they apply from its renewal, by 1 January 2029 at the latest (Art. 50, p. 30). The file applies them from 1 June 2026 everywhere: a worker in a province with a CPL not yet renewed is paid above the national floor in force for that province.
requirements.remediation: Add an employer fact for the CPL status of the province, or pass the minimo in force as an input.

requirements.rule: BILATERAL FUNDS. Art. 7 (printed pp. 9-10) charges the employer for EBAN, which funds the FISA health fund of art. 66, 0.30% (OTI) and 0.60% (OTD) of the retribuzione imponibile ai fini previdenziali from 1 January 2014; a separate agreement splits it among the activities, so the FISA share the INPS solidarity contribution of 10% falls on is not known, and the OTD base includes the terzo elemento a fund rate does not read. Not computed; pass them as BilateralFundEvent. The casse extra legem / EBAT of art. 8 are provincial. Agrifondo is modelled as the employer fund AGRIFONDO.
requirements.remediation: Source the FISA share of the EBAN contribution and compute 0.30% / 0.60% of the INPS base, or pass them as bilateral fund events.

requirements.rule: FLOROVIVAISTI SICKNESS (remaining limits): State EmployerProfile.subsector=florovivaisti for the permanent-worker supplement; without a sub-sector the agricultural rule applies. The provincial contractual daily wage on February 1 is not printed in the national clause and must be supplied for each year of sickness, already prorated for a part-time worker under Art. 17(c) p. 10; an unknown wage or INPS recognition leaves the employer supplement unpaid and flagged. Previously posted months must be rerun if a later relapse extends a short illness beyond three days. Art. 62 also grants fixed-term workers the supplement after 30 continuous days with the same employer, from day 31 for up to 45 days per year; this entitlement is not modeled.
requirements.remediation: State the existing employer sub-sector and the February 1 contractual daily wage by year for permanent workers; source or supply continuous days with the employer and encode the 45-day fixed-term supplement after day 30.

requirements.rule: PROVINCIAL SENIORITY: Art. 54 (pp. 55-56) grants increments only to permanent workers and sets the post-2006 amounts for five profiles, including the two super profiles, selected by Employment.roles. Provincial contracts assign the profiles within the three national areas; the file has no province-specific classification or later provincial scatto schedules. State the provincial worker profile explicitly and verify any provincial override separately.
requirements.remediation: Supply the provincial classification and any province-specific amounts; national profile figures are used until a provincial schedule is sourced.

requirements.rule: Agricultural and floriculture premiums are selected by EmployerProfile.subsector; the 10% of night work in regular shifts (Art. 43 p. 48, Art. 44 p. 49) is paid on a ShiftWorkEvent of kind night. Remaining: the 10% of holiday work in regular shifts without night work (Art. 43), the provincial special tariffs of agriturismo, acquacoltura and the other special works, the terzo elemento on the overtime, holiday and night hours of an OTD, and the bank of hours; provincial contractual wages require local inputs.
requirements.remediation: Supply the contractual hourly wage and provincial special tariffs; route the 10% of holiday work in regular shifts, the third element on these hours and bank-of-hours elections separately.

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded. A CCNL whose comporto the engine counts over the calendar year (Commercio Art. 186 and the others with comporto_calendar_year) is not affected.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.
